title: Existence of a "maximal" domain of meromorphy for an analytic function outside a polar compact set
summary: Let E be a polar compact set in $\mathbb C$. Let $f_\infty$ be a germ at $\infty$ that can be analytically continued along an arbitrary path $γ$ lying in $\widehat{\mathbb C}\setminus E$ and starting at the point $\infty$. In 1985--1986 Herbert Stahl presented his proof of a fundamental theorem on the convergence of diagonal Padé approximants constructed from such germ $f_\infty$. Since then, this theorem has borne his name.
